name: Takaida Yayoi
source:
She is the granddaughter of the current Prime Minister, Kozo Takaida.
She is a third-year student at Kurasaki Academy and is the student council president.

She respects her family, who are all politicians, especially her grandfather, who is also the Prime Minister, and believes that he is an honest, upstanding, and ideal politician like no other.

She grew up in a home where she lacked nothing, has excellent grades, is good at sports, is cheerful, and has many friends.

However, most of her friends draw a line around her being the Prime Minister's granddaughter, and she has no one she can call her best friend.

Although she is not clearly aware of the people around her being considerate of her, she does feel a sense of loneliness, and since she started living with Kagari, she feels like she has found a best friend.

As a result of being raised as a sheltered daughter, she ends up falling into the hands of Kazuki.
